what: A completed trading session, 2026-10-23, was absent from both the intraday and the end-of-day store. This records how it was detected, how it was confirmed against the exchange's own data, and what was acquired.
how_it_surfaced: Checking whether F02's in-session publication requirement could be verified today. Today is Sunday 2026-10-25, so it cannot; walking the calendar either side of today against the broker's data showed the store ending a session earlier than the exchange had traded.

calendar_versus_broker.probe: RELIANCE 5-minute candles, the most liquid member; a day with no candles did not trade

the_gap.confirmed_a_real_session_by: the broker returned a full 72-candle session for RELIANCE
the_gap.cause_not_investigated_beyond_this: no acquisition ran after the Friday close; the news supervisor had already died at 18:26:54 and nothing else advanced the market corpus

intraday.note: 6,864 bars is exactly what every other recent all-member session carries, so the session is complete rather than partially recovered

end_of_day.source: NSE public bhavcopy archive; no credentials needed for end-of-day

2026_10_20_is_not_a_defect.correction: An earlier version of this record said the calendar was wrong about 2026-10-20 and had been left unpatched because no ingested exchange calendar exists. That was wrong. The probe used a bare SessionCalendar(), not the production entry point.
2026_10_20_is_not_a_defect.finding: An evidence-pinned exchange calendar exists and is configured at prototype_runs/exchange_calendar/current.json, covering 2026-10-19 to 2026-10-23, pinned to NSE circular CMTR71775.pdf with its sha256 and retrieval time. seraph.market_calendar.exchange.configured() returns is_session=False for 2026-10-20 with verified_for=True, agreeing with the broker and with both stores. seraph/live/clock.py consults exactly this.
2026_10_20_is_not_a_defect.fallback_clarified: SessionCalendar's weekday() < 5 rule is only the fallback for when no such document is installed, which is what seraph/operations/schedule.py documents when it says inventing a holiday table would be fabricating exchange data.
2026_10_20_is_not_a_defect.coverage_limit: 2026-10-26, the next session, is OUTSIDE the declared interval, so configured() reports is_session=True with verified_for=False. The interval needs extending before Monday can be called a verified session.
2026_10_20_is_not_a_defect.real_inconsistency_left_alone: scripts/backfill_intraday.py builds a bare SessionCalendar() instead of calling configured(), so its _last_completed_session_close would treat a closed day as a completed session. Traced through it changes no outcome: a window ending at a close on a non-trading day still ends at or after the previous real session's close, so it cannot truncate bars, which is the failure that function exists to prevent. Behaviour-neutral, and configured() can raise on a malformed document, so it was not swapped mid-acquisition. One-line change if the two paths should agree.

f02_in_session_requirement.reason: A genuine in-session current publication needs a live session. Today is Sunday 2026-10-25.
f02_in_session_requirement.prerequisite_now_met: both stores reach the last completed session, 2026-10-23
